items.title: Al Rose Interview, 1975-02-03
items.q: [INTERVIEWER] Well, he must have heard several tones. There's another Harry Smith that I've heard of somewhere.

ctx.x: Yeah. And Danny Barker was on that session too. Yeah. And so was a young guitar player by the name of Herman Mitchell and Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius Darius…
Well, he must have heard several tones. There's another Harry Smith that I've heard of somewhere. Well, did you ever do any recording sessions in New Orleans?

Oh, yeah, of course. Well of course I did a lot of recording sessions in cooperation with Joe Merez. Some of them were mine, some of them were his. And I think I recall that you were present at some of the sessions. I think you were at Woodman of the World Hall when we made the Kingsville Parade with Johnny Wiggs and Raymond Burke and Emil Christian, Jeff Riddick, Paul Barberan, Sherwood Mangiapani.
